title: Copilot Studio: Dataverse tables as a native knowledge source for agents
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, Dataverse prerequisites, access boundaries and billing claims remain supported by current Microsoft documentation. Minor corrections should preserve the 12-hour qualification for rebuilding the search index, use the documented Microsoft 365 Copilot licence name and complete the background knowledge-source setting path.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Dataverse as a native knowledge source grounding agents in records, customer data, operational data and business application content.
claims.quote: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data.
